title: Audi has a new flagship designed with the US in mind: The 2027 Q9
gist: Audi unveiled the 2027 Q9, a 209-inch full-size SUV built for the US Escalade-class segment on VW Group's Premium Platform Combustion, starting at $87,700 with a 2.9 L V6 and a twin-turbo V8 SQ9 at $118,000. With no concrete A8 sedan replacement planned, this combustion SUV becomes Audi's flagship, and it brings active-matrix LED headlights to the US market for the first time when it arrives in Q4.

insights.claim: Audi's 2027 Q9 targets the US-specific full-size SUV segment pioneered by the Cadillac Escalade, one size above the Q7 which was designed first and foremost for Europe.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: A German premium brand entering the Escalade-class segment signals where volume and margin now sit in US luxury.
insights.locator: But in America, there’s a segment one size larger

insights.claim: With no concrete plans yet to replace the A8 sedan, the Q9 SUV becomes Audi's new brand flagship, marking the completion of the sedan-to-SUV shift at the top of the range.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Flagship sedans are being abandoned even at the premium German brands; read across to Mercedes and BMW sedan strategy.
insights.quote: the Q9 SUV becomes the brand’s new flagship
insights.locator: With no concrete plans to replace the A8 sedan yet

insights.claim: The Q9 measures 209 inches long on a 123.5-inch wheelbase, 5.6 inches longer than the Q7's, with most of the gain going to third-row room, yet it is still a few inches smaller than the Cadillac Escalade.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Audi is undersizing the segment leader, which constrains the third-row and towing pitch against domestic full-size rivals.

insights.claim: The Q9 uses Volkswagen Group's new Premium Platform Combustion architecture shared with the Q7, A5 and Q5, meaning Audi's new flagship is explicitly a combustion vehicle rather than an EV.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: A major German group is investing its flagship launch in a combustion platform, a concrete data point on EV timeline retrenchment.
insights.locator: Like the Q7 (and the new A5 and Q5), the Q9 uses

insights.claim: At launch the Q9 gets one of Audi's 2.9 L V6 engines, while the SQ9 variant uses the twin-turbo V8 found in some RS6 and RS7 models with rear-biased all-wheel drive for daily driving.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: V8 availability in a new 2027 flagship indicates Audi expects US emissions rules to stay permissive through the model cycle.
insights.quote: Audi says that unlike the regular Q9, the SQ9’s all-wheel drive power delivery is rear-biased for daily driving.
insights.locator: At launch, it will come with one of Audi’s 2.9 L V6 engines

insights.claim: The Q9 starts at $87,700 and the SQ9 at $118,000, placing Audi's new flagship in direct price competition with the Mercedes-Benz GLS and BMW X7.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: An $87,700 entry point and a $30,000 performance step-up define the ASP and mix opportunity for Audi's US business.
insights.quote: The Q9 will start at $87,700, with the SQ9 starting at $118,000.

insights.claim: Cargo capacity runs from 19.3 cubic feet with the third row up to 87.7 cubic feet with all seats flat, with towing rated at 7,700 lbs and a choice of six-seat captain's chairs or a three-seat middle bench.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Specification parity with the segment is table stakes; these are the numbers US buyers cross-shop against the Escalade.

themes.theme: Lighting technology as a US first

insights.claim: Audi will finally bring its active-matrix LED headlights to the US with the Q9's arrival in the last quarter of the year, allowing selective beam dimming to avoid dazzling oncoming drivers while projecting driving aids like lane markers onto the road.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: US adaptive-beam headlight deployment has been regulatory-blocked for years; this launch marks the practical unlock date.

insights.claim: The Q9 and Q7 also get turn signals that project indicators onto the roadway to make them more visible to cyclists and pedestrians, extending exterior lighting into an active safety function.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Lighting is becoming a differentiated safety feature rather than a styling item, which favors suppliers with matrix LED capability.

insights.claim: The Q9 arrives in the US in the last quarter of the year, ahead of its 2027 model-year designation.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: A Q4 on-sale date puts first deliveries and pricing validation inside the current fiscal year.
